deployment.delivery: Source-built company-hosted service; no customer backend/image delivery identified

networkSource: All actual remote users receive matching modified app/API/portal and workspace source, schemas, locks and build/install material through existing browser or API authentication. No extra source role, NDA or code-host privilege.
dependencies: Unmodified public build inputs have exact registry URLs/SRI in DEPENDENCY-SOURCES.json. General-purpose tools/free programs are not bundled as thousands of registry archives. Local dependency patches, if introduced, must be included. Original supplier terms remain independent.

dub.scope: Embed core/react and their TypeScript configuration only; outside the supplier's two EE exceptions. Published npm versions 0.0.16 name this gitHead; source manifests at that gitHead say 0.0.15, retained without alteration.

tracing: Unlicensed-declaration @inference/tracing removed. First-party optional OTLP adapter uses existing Apache-2.0 OpenTelemetry packages, defaults disabled, and does not record prompts/responses.

fonts.terms: apps/app/public/fonts/Inter-OFL.txt and apps/portal/public/fonts/Inter-OFL.txt; original attribution/provenance retained
fonts.generalSans: Removed from active app/portal source and new image inputs; historical copies are not deleted or retrospectively cleared

native.observed: Live API maps sharp-linux-x64.node 0.34.5 and libvips-cpp.so.8.17.3 from @img/sharp-libvips-linux-x64 1.2.4. App/portal contain glibc/musl packages but no mapping was observed during inspection; lazy use remains possible.
native.decision: Unmodified general-purpose native libraries accessed through the standard Sharp package, not locally modified or statically joined to proprietary objects. Company-hosted operation does not itself convey backend/container copies to customers. Exact public source/build references are retained in legal/source-evidence/native.json. No claim that a tag alone proves runtime identity or that future customer image delivery is cleared.

futureDelivery: Reassess binary/native source and any applicable LGPL replacement/relink delivery before customer/on-prem image conveyance; this release is an internal hosted source offer.
